title: マイルCSの後に・アツアツ激突！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The clash between Hishi Akebono's sheer power and Biko Pegasus's infallible spirit electrifies the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both of them are equally fired up, and Biko Pegasus is overcome with joy when she remembers how to run her own way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They promise to run against each other in an even bigger race and set a rematch for the upcoming Takamatsunomiya Kinen!
